english.title: Supplied construction product without declaration of performance and UK Marking affixed to it
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4(1) and (6) of the Construction Products Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who supplied a construction product that is covered by a designated standard or conforms to a UK Technical Assessment that has been issued for it
failed to supply a declaration of the performance of the product in accordance with Article 7 of Regulation (EU) No 305/2011 and/or affix to it the UK marking in accordance with Article 8(1) of Regulation (EU) No 305/2011

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A declaration of performance for the product must be drawn up in accordance with Articles 4 and 6 of Regulation (EU) No 305/2011.
(ii) This offence does not apply to products that are subjected to one or more of the derogations in Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 305/2011.

other.penalty: Summary imprisonable: maximum three months imprisonment and / or a fine. On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level five on the legislative standard scale
